name: Ankle Osteoarthritis
definition: Degenerative arthritis of the tibiotalar joint, frequently post-traumatic, causing pain, stiffness and reduced walking tolerance.

investigations.principle: Weight-bearing radiographs are central; CT/MRI is selected for alignment, cartilage or surgical planning.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Injection, arthrodesis or ankle replacement are individualized by severity and patient factors.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gulpha Sandhigata-Vata correlation may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Degenerative arthritis of the tibiotalar joint, frequently post-traumatic, causing pain, stiffness and reduced walking tolerance.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
